notes: Flown on sctsvr6 (headless Linux, Docker, Mesa lavapipe) in tmux after an unscored shakedown, then R11C at the same SHA. 18/18 valid. 11/18 (initial 6/6, final 4/6, dynamic 1/6); R11C 11/18. a16 not dropped (0 of 4 drop conditions); 6 of 18 outcomes changed against R11C (3 gained, 3 lost), not more than the floor of max(6, 2) = 6, so by the pre-registered rule no change is credited.
